scripts.setup: npm run -w @offline-maps/shared build && npm run -w @offline-maps/backend setup
scripts.assets:fetch: npm run -w @offline-maps/shared build && npm run -w @offline-maps/backend assets:fetch
scripts.dev: npm run -w @offline-maps/shared build && concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run -w @offline-maps/shared build && npm run -w @offline-maps/backend build && npm run -w @offline-maps/frontend build
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w @offline-maps/shared build && npm run --workspaces --if-present typecheck
